title: World dressing: find and fill empty ground

items.name: Emptiness audit script + ranked list + heatmap
Root causes of flagged empty areas found and fixed or reported
Real parking lots dressed (worn asphalt, stalls, curbs, wheel stops, poles, islands, parked cars, pay stations, signs)
General dressing (grass variation, shrubs, palms, fences, utility poles and wires, mailboxes, dumpsters, benches, shelters, news boxes, hydrants, planters, bike racks)
Beach gear (umbrellas, lifeguard towers, chairs, coolers)
Marina and Keys dressing (boat trailers, mangroves, coral rock, crab traps, buoys, weathered docks)
Spawn neighborhood at Nico's house (neighbor houses and yards, parked cars, boats on trailers, power lines, bait shop, water view)
Performance: instancing, time-sliced per-region build, far LOD, no frame over 33 ms while streaming
Before/after shots: p4_front_dry spot, 5 flagged areas, spawn at 9 AM (player cam + overview)
